# Jeduka

> > International education portal helping students find universities, courses, and admission requirements across USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and Europe with detailed IELTS, TOEFL, GMAT, and GRE guidance.

Jeduka provides comprehensive information on studying abroad, including university profiles, program details, tuition fees, visa requirements, and standardized test requirements. The platform covers major study destinations and helps international students navigate the admission process from application to enrollment.

## Key Topics

- IELTS and TOEFL requirements
- GMAT and GRE test scores
- International student admissions
- Tuition fees and cost of study
- Study abroad destinations (USA, UK, Canada, Australia)
- University rankings and comparisons
- Student visa applications (F1, J1, M1)
- MBA and Masters programs
- Engineering programs
- Banking and Finance courses
- PTE and Duolingo English tests
- SAT requirements
- Entry requirements and eligibility
- Course finder and program search
- University profiles and reviews

- [Top Universities in Romania | Courses, Admission, Ranking & More](https://www.jeduka.com/romania/universities): Romania universities directory with courses, rankings, admission info
